name: moles-under-the-pitch-site
description: Static public site for the Moles Under the Pitch educational project.

scripts.build: node scripts/render-updates.mjs && npm --prefix ../browser-client run build:play && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test:browser: npm run build && node --test test/play-browser.test.mjs test/current-games-browser.test.mjs test/spectate-browser.test.mjs test/updates-browser.test.mjs test/builder-browser.test.mjs test/m5d-blitz-browser.test.mjs test/m5e-result-browser.test.mjs test/m5f-keyboard-browser.test.mjs && npm --prefix ../browser-client run test:interaction
